title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
**Job Description**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Function: Engineering / Platform & Data Infrastructure**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise SaaS applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Database Design & Architecture**

* Architect and implement scalable, high-availability MongoDB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures.
* Design, implement, and manage MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production.
* Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning.

**Production Reliability & Operations**

* Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance.
* Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures.
* Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime.

**Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms.
* Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads.

**Security & Reliability**

* Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership.
* Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and DevOps teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of database engineering, DBRE, DBA, or related experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on MongoDB production support experience.
* Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience.
* Experience managing databases supporting enterprise SaaS applications and millions of records.
* Cloud experience on Azure , AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills.
* Programming experience in .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or similar technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MongoDB Certified DBA or Developer certification.
* MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience.
* Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations.
* Background in SaaS, telemetry, IoT, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.

**About Us**

title: Database Analyst, Officer
description:
The Database Analyst will support the day-to-day operation, stability, and readiness of end-to-end QA environments used to validate application releases, patches, hotfixes, integration workflows, automation runs, and client-like testing scenarios. The role requires hands-on ownership of database and cache readiness across Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, RocksDB, and Redis, with a strong emphasis on reliable test data, environment consistency, rapid troubleshooting and clear coordination with QA, Development, Release Management, and Platform teams. They will ensure environments are available, correctly configured, appropriately seeded, validated after deployments, and recoverable when test cycles encounter data, schema, connectivity, or cache-state issues. This candidate will also be a key contributor towards defining, deploying, and governing the unified data platform in the end-to-end QA environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide daily operational support for end-to-end QA, integration, patch, hotfix, release candidate, smoke test, automation, and client-like non-production environments.
* Monitor database and cache readiness before, during, and after deployments, including validating connectivity, data availability, schema compatibility, permissions, job completion, and environment-specific configuration.
* Serve as the primary database analyst for end-to-end environment related issues, triaging incidents, identifying root cause, coordinating fixes, and communicating status to stakeholders.
* Support repeatable setup, teardown, refresh, and re-seeding activities so QA teams may execute tests against predictable and consistent baselines.
* Maintain environment parity across supported QA and end-to-end landscapes, identifying drift in schemas, configuration, reference data, security grants, or cache state.
* Define and own the unified data platform for QA including architecture, governance, component reusability, synthetic data generation, data shape simulation, and data readiness.
* Enable self-service data capabilities across the broader end-to-end platform supporting the overall autonomous data provisioning for QA automation.
* Design and scale reusable test data services for workflow-driven automation by building data components, data profiles, synthetic data generation, and autonomous provisioning capabilities across UAP.
* Partner with pillar teams to enable data-aware, environment-independent workflow execution while ensuring data quality, security, governance, and CI/CD integration at enterprise scale.
* DBA should have some QA familiarity with this, it’s not just a production DBA kind of thing, it is supporting QA standards and acting as a Data Steward.
* The candidate must have experience in synthetic test data generation and data shape simulation, with the ability to seed realistic client-like datasets for QA workflows, automation, regression, and end-to-end testing

**Technical Environment / Qualifications**

* Required: Minimum 10 years of experience as a Database Analyst.
* Hands-on experience support database environments in QA, UAT, integration staging and other non-production settings
* Strong SQL skills including joins, data validation queries, data comparison, troubleshooting and ad hoc analysis
* Practical experience with at least two of the following platforms: SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, RocksDB, or Redis; willingness to learn the remaining platforms.
* Ability to analyze data-flow issues across upstream and downstream systems, including batch jobs, workflow execution, and integration services.
* Familiarity with cloud-hosted environments, Azure services, Kubernetes-based deployments, data pipelines, or workflow orchestration tools.
* Proven ability to design and execute data-driven and workflow-driven automation test scenarios
* Exposure to synthetic test data generation techniques (e.g. using Python, Faker libraries, or custom generators)
* Strong understanding of test data management concepts, including data setup, teardown, and dependency handling
* Experience integration automation with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in data-intensive environments such as: Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, ETL / data pipeline systems
* Strong experience writing complex SQL queries for large-scale data validation and reconciliation
* Experience with data masking, anonymization, or production data scrubbing techniques, including maintaining referential integrity
* Understanding of data security and data privacy best practices, especially related to handling sensitive or PII data

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Application Consultant designs, builds, and maintains Power BI reporting and analytics solutions that enable Operations and business teams to make data-driven decisions. Works with stakeholders to define requirements and KPIs, translates needs into curated datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and actionable insights, and contributes to the data foundation through SQL and Databricks (light-to-medium transformations and curated data layers) as needed. Ensures analytics assets are accurate, performant, well-governed, and easy to use.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

* Partner with Operations and business stakeholders to understand processes, KPIs, and reporting needs; translate requirements into user-friendly analytics solutions.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports with strong visual design, performance optimization, and clear storytelling for executive and operational audiences, including building reusable measures, KPI cards, and (where appropriate) leveraging custom visuals/components to improve usability.
* Build curated datasets and analytical models using SQL and Databricks (e.g., notebooks/ETL/ELT) to support trusted, reusable reporting and self-service analytics.
* Design semantic models in Power BI (data modeling, relationships, measures) and develop robust DAX calculations (measures, time intelligence, and reusable KPI logic) aligned to agreed KPI definitions.
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency across sources, models, and reports.
* Apply governance and security best practices (workspace/dataset access, row-level security where applicable), documentation, and change control for analytics products.
* Perform exploratory analysis to derive insights, identify trends/anomalies, and provide recommendations that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Enable self-service analytics by creating curated datasets, data dictionaries, and usage guidance; coach end users on interpreting dashboards and metrics.
* Identify creative ways to deliver insights (e.g., interactive storytelling, narrative summaries, alerts, and guided self-service) and support capability uplift by enabling business users on available analytics features (including Databricks Genie where applicable).
* Support production reporting by troubleshooting issues, performing root-cause analysis, and delivering enhancements with minimal disruption to stakeholders.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Partners with Operations and business teams to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and decision workflows.
* Collaborates with data engineering and platform teams to align on data sourcing, transformations, and modeling in SQL/Databricks environments.
* Works with technology, risk, and information security partners to ensure appropriate access controls, data handling, and compliance for analytics assets.
* Partners with product owners and project teams to prioritize analytics roadmaps and deliver incremental value.
* Engages with BI administrators/support teams for workspace management, deployments, and operational support.
* Coordinates with data owners and subject-matter experts to validate definitions, lineage, and data quality.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Individual contributor role focused on delivering analytics products (datasets, dashboards, insights) that support operational and business decision-making.
* Works across multiple data domains and sources; responsible for shaping data into trusted, consumable models for reporting and self-service analysis.
* Acts as an advisor to stakeholders on KPI definition, data interpretation, and dashboard usage to improve adoption and outcomes.

**Experience:**
7+ years of experience

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related field.

**Must Have Skills:**

* Minimum 7+ years of experience in BI/data analytics and reporting in an enterprise environment.
* Proven experience delivering dashboards end-to-end: requirements, data sourcing, modeling, visualization, validation, and rollout/adoption.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (Power Query, data modeling, DAX, performance tuning, publishing and workspace management).
* Proficiency in SQL (complex queries, performance optimization, data profiling, and dimensional modeling concepts).
* Experience with Python (e.g., pandas) for analysis, automation, and data validation
* Experience with Databricks for data engineering/analytics (notebooks, transformations, orchestration patterns) and working with large datasets.
* Experience building reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT), handling slowly changing data, and implementing data quality checks.
* Understanding of data governance fundamentals (data definitions, lineage, access controls, and privacy/security considerations).
* Familiarity with source control and release practices for analytics (e.g., Git), and documenting requirements, logic, and metric definitions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to translate complex data into clear storytelling, recommendations, and decision-ready insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical and detail-oriented; comfortable working in ambiguity, prioritizing requests, and iterating quickly to improve dashboard usability, stakeholder adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience partnering with Operations teams and/or working with regulated data and controls (financial services preferred) is a strong asset.
* Strong dimensional data modeling experience (e.g., star schema, Kimball concepts) for analytics and reporting.
* Experience with data visualization libraries/tools (e.g., Plotly, Python visualization libraries).

**Privacy:**

By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: System Engineer
description:
**Role: Cloud Engineer, Systems**

**Windows or Linux Server Engineering in the Cloud**

**Role Summary**

We are moving customer workloads into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and running them on a managed services platform built as code. As a Cloud Engineer, Systems, you are the server expert on the team: you build, migrate, and support customer Windows or Linux servers using the platform automation, and you extend that automation for operating system tasks. You will also provide Tier 2 support for customer environments already in production.

We are hiring for both Windows-focused and Linux-focused engineers under this role. The focus is server and cloud infrastructure engineering. Deep expertise in Oracle applications or databases is not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

Server Build and Configuration

* Deploy customer servers through the team's OpenTofu modules, Ansible playbooks, and CI/CD pipelines, and extend them when a build needs something new.
* Configure, harden, and patch Windows or Linux servers to platform standards using Ansible, including monitoring, backup, and security agents.
* Handle directory integration, DNS, storage, and application prerequisites at the operating system level.

Migrations

* Set up and monitor workload replication, execute cutovers, and run post-cutover checks from documented runbooks.
* Fix operating system issues after migration: boot, drivers, networking, licensing and activation, and performance.
* Handle older and end-of-life operating systems, recommending the safest path to migrate or upgrade them.

Customer Environment Support

* Provide Tier 2 support for running customer environments: troubleshoot incidents, fulfill service requests, and execute changes following change management processes.
* Perform backup restores and take part in disaster recovery tests.
* Escalate complex issues to the Cloud Architect with clear findings and next steps.

Automation and Documentation

* Write Python, PowerShell, or Bash automation for repeatable operating system tasks, delivered through GitHub pull requests.
* Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles for the servers you build and support, so Tier 1 engineers can operate them without escalating.
* Work second shift with overlap for handoffs to the US team, and join the on-call rotation after onboarding.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years in systems administration or engineering, including 2+ years supporting servers in a major public cloud (OCI, Azure, or AWS).
* Deep, hands-on expertise in either Windows Server or Linux, with working knowledge of the other.
* Windows focus: Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP, Group Policy, IIS, patching, and performance troubleshooting.
* Linux focus: Oracle Linux, RHEL, or Ubuntu administration, systemd, LVM and file systems, package management, SELinux, patching, and performance troubleshooting.
* Scripting for automation: Python, plus PowerShell for Windows or Bash for Linux.
* Working knowledge of Terraform or OpenTofu: reading, running, and extending existing modules.
* Ansible: writing and maintaining playbooks and roles for Windows or Linux configuration (or strong experience with a comparable tool such as Chef, Puppet, or PowerShell DSC).
* Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests, and code review.
* Core cloud services in at least one major cloud: compute, block storage, virtual networking, and identity and access management.
* Experience supporting production environments: incident troubleshooting, service requests, and change execution.
* Lifelong learner: self-driven to research, study documentation and training videos, and figure out unfamiliar technologies on the fly.
* Sound judgment in handling customer data securely and working within compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable documenting work and collaborating with US-based team members.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* OCI hands-on experience (strongly preferred). Candidates with strong Azure or AWS backgrounds who are ready to ramp on OCI are encouraged to apply.
* Server migration into public cloud, using tools such as OCI Cloud Migrations, RackWare, Azure Migrate, or AWS Application Migration Service.
* Image and bootstrap tooling such as Packer or cloud-init.
* Backup and disaster recovery tooling (OCI Full Stack DR, Azure Site Recovery, or similar).
* Hands-on experience across more than one public cloud.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Managed-services or MSP experience.
* Certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft AZ-800/AZ-801, AZ-104, OCI Architect Associate, or equivalent.

description:

 As a Database Engineer for the Data Engineering team, you will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the reliability of our data infrastructure. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, and software engineers to develop and drive 100% automation, best practices for deep monitoring and alerting.

* Database Strategy \& Technical Leadership: Act as the strategic subject matter expert for database engine best practices, storage engines, and long\-term data placement strategy across the broader engineering organization. Partner with tech leadership to raise the collective database expertise of the team.
* SQL Optimization \& Application Performance: Drive deep application performance analysis. Own the identification, debugging, and elimination of query execution bottlenecks, optimizing raw SQL, missing indexes, execution plans, and data models to maximize throughput and minimize latency.
* Cloud Database Architecture \& Scale: Design, scale, and evaluate schemas leveraging AWS\-native database services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL), and NoSQL engines (DynamoDB), ensuring systems adhere strictly to rigorous scalability benchmarks.
* Database Internals \& Systems Analysis: Execute deep\-dive performance forensics into database engine behaviors, memory structures, replication lag, locking mechanisms, and OS/hardware saturation metrics (such as Disk/IO performance) to preemptively address platform degradation.
* Engineering Mentorship \& Advisory: Partner closely with internal application development and data teams to review data access patterns, optimize application\-level database interaction layers, and establish organizational standards around indexing and schema configurations.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Database SRE specialists to ensure highly optimized query layouts, correct database configuration and schemas translate seamlessly into platform automation and IaC frameworks.


**About You**
 We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in database operations, or a related role with a focus on data platforms, data stores, data operations.
* Deep experience in AWS RDS, Aurora and NoSQL is a must.
* Extensive experience with AWS cloud platform and their data\-related services.
* Proficiency in monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, DevOps Guru, DB Performance Insights).
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, Java)
* Strong understanding of various performance metrics both at a high level and at a low level like Disk/IO saturation.
* Experience in identifying and eliminating the bottlenecks in the system.
* Strong understanding of database internals like types of indexes, schemas, query plans.
* Strong understanding of database systems (e.g., SQL, NoSQL) and experience in managing large\-scale data infrastructures.
* Basic knowledge and some hands\-on implementation of CI/CD pipelines and DatabaseOps practices.
* Experience with data governance, compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues.
* Ability to independently own and execute projects while effectively collaborating with the team to influence and shape the vision of the data engineering organization.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to mentor and guide junior engineers.


**About The Team**
 The Database Engineering team is dedicated to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our data infrastructure. Additionally, we define and document operational requirements, develop incident response processes, and automate monitoring and compliance checks to maintain a secure and reliable data environment. By continuously improving load testing and optimizing data governance practices, we support the overall health and efficiency of our data systems.

**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it \- and that's what you build.
   

  

 You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI\-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands\-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production\-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design and implement production\-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.
   

  

 Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.
   

  

 Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast\-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.
   

  

 Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.
   

  

 Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.
   

  

 Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.
   

  

 Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well\-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.
   

  

 Apply AI\-DLC (AI\-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI\-native for accelerated scale and pace.

title: Technology Solution Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands\-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.
   

  

 At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.
   

  

 The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Consulting and Design**
* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.
* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.
* Produce options analyses with honest trade\-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.
* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non\-functional requirements.


**Cross\-Platform Solution Delivery**
* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.
* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.
* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.
* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.


**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**
* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.
* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.
* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root\-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.


**Security, Compliance, and Risk**
* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.
* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud\-native key services.
* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.


**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**
* Write clean, tested, peer\-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk\-based practices.
* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.


**Collaboration and Ways of Working**
* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service\-level objectives.
* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade\-offs in plain language.
* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.
* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.
* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.
* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.
* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.
* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.
* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.
* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.
* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data\-protection obligations such as GDPR.
* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.


**Core Competencies**
* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem
* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness
* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several
* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility
* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification
* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation
* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them


**Measures of Success**
* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline
* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build
* Reduced defects, rework, and post\-implementation incidents
* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions
* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions
* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions
* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored

description:
****Company Description****
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. ****Job Description****
**Job description**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Data Migration Engineer
   

  

**Summary**
 The Data Migration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting data replication, migration, and integration solutions across cloud and on\-prem environments. This role ensures secure, reliable, and high\-performance data movement between heterogeneous systems, leveraging modern ETL tools, lakehouse technologies, and DevOps practices. The role carries platform and administration responsibilities for the Snowflake environment and the AWS data platform services that support it, and requires 24x7 operational support for mission\-critical data pipelines.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Data replication and migration
   

  

* Design and implement data replication and migration solutions across multiple platforms (AWS DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, DB2, Snowflake).
* Develop and maintain ETL workflows using AWS services (DMS, Glue) and other integration tools.
* Ensure data integrity, latency, and SLA compliance for replication and migration processes.
* Plan and execute migrations off legacy on\-prem estates into AWS, including validation, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning.
* Provide 24x7 support for data replication platforms, including incident management and root cause analysis.
* Monitor and optimize replication performance, ensuring scalability and cost efficiency.


 Platform and DevOps engineering
   

  

* Build and operate data platform services on AWS, including AWS Glue (ETL jobs, crawlers, Data Catalog), AWS Lambda, S3, Step Functions, and EventBridge.
* Develop and maintain lakehouse ingestion patterns using Apache Hudi (upserts, incremental processing, compaction, clustering, schema evolution), with awareness of comparable open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* Implement DevOps practices for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation), including automated testing and promotion between environments.
* Deploy and support Windows and Linux compute in AWS (EC2, clustering, networking, IAM) in support of replication and migration workloads.
* Implement observability across the platform: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboarding (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).


 Snowflake administration
   

  

* Administer the Snowflake platform as day\-to\-day operational owner: account, database, schema, and warehouse management.
* Design and manage role\-based access control (RBAC), including role hierarchies and integration with enterprise identity (SSO/SCIM).
* Manage warehouse sizing, auto\-suspend/auto\-resume, resource monitors, and query optimization to control cost and performance.
* Operate ingestion into Snowflake via bulk loading (COPY INTO), Snowpipe, tasks, streams, and S3\-based staging, alongside third\-party replication tooling.
* Implement platform governance: data masking, row access policies, tagging, time travel/retention configuration, and usage monitoring.
* Establish and maintain runbooks, standards, and documentation for Snowflake administration, and support knowledge transfer across the team.


 Security, governance, and collaboration
   

  

* Maintain compliance with security standards, including encryption in transit and at rest, IAM roles and policies, and vulnerability management.
* Collaborate with architecture and security teams to validate designs and ensure adherence to governance policies.
* Partner with business units and vendors (including vendor engineering/professional services teams) to deliver strategic data integration solutions.


**Skills \& Qualifications Core Expertise**
* Minimum 3 years in data replication, migration, and integration engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS Data Migration Service (DMS), AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and S3\-based staging for Snowflake.
* Practical experience with Apache Hudi or a comparable open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake) in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture and administration: RBAC, warehouse and cost management, bulk loading (COPY INTO), and Snowpipe.
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL, DB2, and other relational databases.
* Experience migrating or re\-platforming legacy Windows Server workloads into cloud environments.


 Programming \& Automation
   

  

* Scripting skills in Python and Shell; PySpark experience advantageous.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Docker).


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Understanding of TLS/SSL, encryption standards, IAM policies, and vulnerability management.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with ETL/replication tools (Qlik Replicate, Matillion, Fivetran) is a plus.
* Knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Experience supporting the handover or transition of platform services between teams.


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Data Engineer Associate, or Data Analytics Specialty.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Administrator Certification.
* DevOps\-related certifications.


**Other Requirements**
* Ability to work in a 24x7 operational support model.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Experience in Agile environments and ITSM tools (ServiceNow).


**Qualifications**
* Appropriate degree level or equivalent qualification.
* AWS experience.
* Snowflake administration.
* Database technology experience.

**Qualifications**

title: Data & AI Platform Associate
description:
**What We're Building**
 We're a small team building AI\-powered solutions for real enterprise problems — autonomous agents, intelligent workflows, and the data infrastructure that makes them work. We work on Microsoft Azure and Fabric, and we move fast.
   

  

 This is an early\-career role with a real growth path. You'll start on the data layer — pipelines, lakehouses, connecting enterprise systems — and grow into understanding AI systems, business processes, and eventually how solutions are designed and delivered.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Build and maintain data pipelines on Microsoft Fabric — ingesting data from enterprise systems into OneLake, keeping it clean, structured, and reliable.
   

  

 Set up and manage Lakehouse structures — understand what data exists, what it means, and how it should be organised for the systems that consume it.
   

  

 Support the AI and agent layer — work with the engineering team to make sure the right data reaches the right agent at the right time, in the right shape.
   

  

 Build dashboards and reports in Power BI that give stakeholders real visibility into what's happening operationally.
   

  

 Get close to the problem — understand why the data exists, not just how to move it. Ask the questions that help the team build the right thing.
   

  

 Take ownership — pipelines break, data goes missing, things go wrong at the wrong time. You're the person who notices, fixes it, and tells the team what happened.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric — you've worked on at least one real project involving Fabric pipelines, Lakehouse, or Power BI. You're not an expert but you're not starting from zero.
   

  

 Data literacy — you can look at a schema or a dataset and understand what the business is doing. You notice when something looks wrong without being told to check.
   

  

 Curiosity about the problem, not just the task — you ask what the data will be used for. You want to understand the system, not just your part of it.
   

  

 Ownership mentality — you don't wait to be told when something is broken. You don't close a ticket without making sure the problem is actually solved.
   

  

 Clear communication — you can explain a data issue to someone non\-technical without losing them. You can write a clear summary of what you found and what you did about it.
   

  

 Willingness to learn fast — this project uses Azure AI Foundry, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines. You haven't necessarily touched these. You will. Fast.
   

  

**Experience Range: 8\-10 yrs
   

  

**Engagement:****
 3\-month project\-based consulting role, with a possibility of extension based on client requirements and project needs.
   

  

**Good To Have**
 Exposure to Azure services — Data Factory, Event Hub, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB.
   

  

 Some Python or SQL beyond the basics — enough to debug a pipeline or transform data when a no\-code tool doesn't cut it.

description:
**Job Description**
**R419034 Manager, Data Stewardship**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
   

  

 Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
   

  

 This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Manager, SCM Data Stewardship plays a key role in the creation, maintenance, accuracy, and compliant execution of master data supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management operations. The role combines hands\-on master data stewardship responsibilities with the leadership and development of a small team of approximately 3–8 Data Stewards.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Global Lead for Data Stewardship for Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management, the Manager supports day\-to\-day master data execution while ensuring team priorities remain aligned with global standards, business requirements, and strategic objectives.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
**Operational Master Data Stewardship**
* Execute and oversee master data creation, extension, update, and maintenance activities supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management processes.
* Perform and support first\-time material code creation, changes, and extensions, including required pre\-checks and validation activities.
* Evaluate appropriate parameters and data sets to enable compliant and error\-free master data changes within SAP ECC and SAP S/4\.
* Ensure required information, documentation, prerequisites, and approvals are available before execution.
* Execute activities in accordance with global SOPs, work instructions, data standards, GxP requirements, and established controls.
* Perform proactive data accuracy checks and support investigation and correction of identified issues.
* Understand dependencies between master data elements and downstream business processes.
* Work closely with Data Steward Leads, ISO Stewards, Supply Chain Management stakeholders, and other relevant teams to clarify requirements and ensure consistent execution.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 3–8 Data Stewards while remaining actively involved in operational master data activities.
* Manage team workload, priorities, and delivery.
* Conduct performance reviews, goal\-setting, feedback, and talent\-development conversations.
* Support onboarding, capability building, knowledge transfer, and individual development.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing team environment.


**Stakeholder and Priority Management**
* Act as an escalation point for complex or unclear master data requests.
* Partner with the Global Lead for Data Stewardship for Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management to align operational priorities, team capacity, risks, and strategic objectives.
* Translate agreed priorities into clear actions for the team.
* Collaborate with business and cross\-functional stakeholders to resolve issues and dependencies.


**Automation and Continuous Improvement**
* Identify and drive opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve master data processes.
* Proactively identify recurring manual activities that could be improved through automation or new technology.
* Support the adoption and effective use of new digital and AI\-enabled tools within Data Stewardship.
* Apply tools such as Gemini to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, problem solving, and ways of working.
* Contribute operational expertise to the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new Master Data Management technologies and capabilities.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant experience in master data management, data stewardship, SAP master data, Supply Chain Management, or related operational roles.
* Previous experience leading or managing a small team.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Strong practical knowledge of SAP master data processes, preferably SAP ECC and SAP S/4\.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Material Master Data creation, maintenance, extension, and change activities.
* Good understanding of Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management processes.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in operational execution.
* Highly organized, with the ability to balance personal operational responsibilities and team priorities.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong people\-management, coaching, and development skills.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong familiarity with Gemini and the ability to use generative AI effectively in day\-to\-day work.
* Strong interest in automation, digital tools, and new technologies and the ability to identify practical opportunities for their application.
* Good understanding of GxP principles and controlled working practices.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Experience within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with SAP S/4 transformation or migration activities.
* Experience with DSP, Syniti, or similar master data tools.
* Experience supporting automation, workflow, or process\-improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with master data governance and stewardship operating models.


**Who We Are**
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today
   

  

**Required Skills**

 and

* Own access certification and periodic access review cycles for Snowflake, producing evidence for

 and

 audits where the underlying product requires it

 **Snowflake** 
 (account management, performance tuning, cost management)
* Working knowledge of
 **dbt** 
 and

 (or comparable ELT tools) for building and troubleshooting data pipelines
* Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data warehousing concepts

 **AWS** 
 with some exposure to
 **Azure** 
 and
 **OCI** 
 , applied to a data platform (IAM, networking, monitoring, automation)

 **user access management** 
 and SSO configuration for a SaaS/cloud platform (Entra ID/Azure AD experience a plus)
* Familiarity with audit/compliance processes (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2\) — access reviews, evidence gathering, control documentation
* Good communication skills — comfortable working with product/platform engineering and security stakeholders

* Experience with Python or equivalent for automation/scripting

title: AI Data Migration Engineer
description:
HapiVet is building an AI\-native practice management platform for veterinary clinics. Every clinic that switches to us brings years of records from the system it is leaving. If that data comes over cleanly, the clinic goes live happy. If it doesn't, we lose them.
 



  





 You'll own that problem. You'll build AI agents and workflows that pull data out of legacy practice management systems, map it, clean it, and load it into HapiVet. Then you'll run them yourself on live migrations, several every week, and keep making them faster and more accurate. You'll work directly with our founder on architecture, and you'll be the person who makes it all work in practice.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Reverse\-engineer old, poorly documented databases and exports, and work out how each one actually stores its data
* Build agent\-driven workflows for extraction, schema mapping, transformation, validation, and loading
* Run multiple clinic migrations every week and own each one end to end, with nothing lost and nothing duplicated
* Write reconciliation checks that prove every migration is correct
* Turn each new source system into a repeatable playbook, so the next clinic on it is faster than the last
* Work with our onboarding team when data is missing, messy, or contradictory



 What we're looking for
 


* 3–5 years of hands\-on data engineering, with real data migration projects in production
* Deep database knowledge. You're fluent in SQL and relational modeling, comfortable in PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL, and unfazed by legacy or on\-prem databases and raw dumps
* You use AI agents every day to get real work done, and you've built workflows around them
* An obsession with data correctness. You check row counts before anyone asks
* Any programming language is fine. We care about how well you know data, not which syntax you use
* Healthcare or practice management data experience is a plus



 Compensation: ₹18–28 LPA, based on experience.
 



  





 Location: Hyderabad, on\-site, full\-time.
 



  





 Apply on LinkedIn or email hr@hapivet.ai with "AI Data Migration Engineer" in the subject.

**This Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high\-quality, well\-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.

* Hands\-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.

* Proven ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.

description:

At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant, you will lead the modernization of business reporting and analytics at CIBC, partnering closely with the Analytics Head Office in Toronto and key business stakeholders.
 



  





 This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets and logic to modern cloud\-based environments. You will help transform legacy SAS/SQL reporting into scalable, business\-ready reporting solutions using SQL, Python, and Power BI or Tableau.
 



 In addition to the existing BI responsibilities, this role requires strong experience in Azure Databricks, experience in building data products, and practical use of AI in previous roles to improve reporting quality, productivity, or modernization outcomes.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role or a source\-system data migration role. The primary focus is on management reporting, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, reporting logic modernization, business insight delivery, and enabling modern BI capabilities through cloud\-based tools and data products.
 



  





 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 



* Reporting \& BI Solution Leadership: Lead the modernization of legacy reporting assets and deliver business\-ready reporting solutions that support decision\-making.
* Own the development and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, recurring management reports, and ad hoc analyses.
* Deliver reporting solutions that are accurate, scalable, user\-friendly, and aligned to business priorities.
* Business Partnership: Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, define KPIs and metrics, and translate business questions into actionable reporting solutions. • Act as a trusted advisor on reporting design, metric interpretation, and business insight delivery.
* Present findings, reporting logic, and recommendations clearly to business audiences with strong communication and confidence.
* Reporting Migration \& Modernization: Lead the migration of business reporting assets, SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic, and analytical workflows into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions. • Convert legacy reporting code and logic into SQL\- and Python\-based solutions that preserve business meaning and reporting integrity.
* Rationalize, simplify, and modernize legacy reports and reporting processes for improved usability and efficiency.
* Dashboarding \& Analytics: Develop advanced dashboards and business intelligence reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Use SQL and Python for analysis, reporting logic, reconciliation, validation, and data preparation in support of reporting outcomes.
* Leverage Azure Databricks as part of the modern analytics ecosystem to support scalable BI and reporting use cases.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis and insight generation for business and leadership teams.
* Data Products: Contribute to the design, build, and evolution of data products that enable reusable, trusted, and business\-consumable data assets.
* Ensure data products are aligned with business outcomes, usability standards, and reporting requirements.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Governance: Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, complete, traceable, and aligned to governance standards and controls.
* Document business logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and key transformations as needed.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues that affect reporting integrity.
* Stakeholder \& Team Leadership: Build strong relationships with business partners, analytics teams, and related stakeholders across functions.
* Handle senior stakeholders effectively and demonstrate strong communication, executive presence, and confidence in discussions and presentations.
* Coach and support team members or junior analysts as appropriate, fostering strong reporting and analytical practices.
* Contribute thought leadership on BI/reporting modernization and business value delivery.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and improve reporting workflows.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support code conversion, reporting quality checks, productivity gains, and insight generation.
* Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, business processes, data products, and reporting operating models.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles.
* Strong experience delivering management reporting, dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and KPI\-based reporting.
* Proven experience modernizing or migrating legacy reporting assets, including SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic.
* Strong track record of working directly with business stakeholders to define and deliver reporting solutions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to reporting transformation or reporting modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience in Azure Databricks as part of cloud\-based analytics or reporting environments.
* Experience handling stakeholders across business and technology teams with strong communication and confidence.
* Experience building data products that support reporting, analytics, or business decision making.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools or automation in previous roles for reporting migration, reporting quality assurance, analytics workflows, or productivity improvement.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; one of these should be a core strength.
* Deep experience in business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and stakeholder\-facing insight delivery.
* Strong understanding of KPI development, metric definition, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, high\-quality reporting solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching, mentoring, or leading workstreams.
* Experience with SAS and legacy reporting environments is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience with Azure Databricks is required. • Experience building data products is highly valued.
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools is required, with practical prior usage preferred.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Exposure to Azure\-based analytics environments.
* Experience with Databricks in business intelligence and analytics use cases.
* Experience with business reporting migration into cloud\-based reporting platforms.
* Experience with both Power BI and Tableau.
* Financial services or regulated industry reporting experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 



* Senior Business Intelligence consultant.
* Reporting and analytics lead.
* BI developer / BI analyst with strong business engagement.
* MIS / management reporting lead.
* Dashboard and KPI reporting specialist.
* Reporting modernization lead.
* Candidates whose experience is primarily in ETL pipeline development, data ingestion, backend data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or source\-to\-target migration without strong business intelligence and reporting delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Title \- Services \& Data Infrastructure Engineer** 




  





**Job Location \- Hyderabad** 




**Mode of Work \- Work from Office/Hybrid** 




**Experience \- 5\+ Years** 




**Mode of employment \- Full Time/Permanent** 




  





**Budget \- 20 LPA** 




  





**Important note:** 
 We are looking for ideal candidates with a strong GCP background, preferably with more hands\-on experience in GCP than Azure.
 



 While the knowledge and skills between Azure and GCP are largely transferable, strong GCP experience is preferred for this requirement.
 



  





**\*About Client\*** 




 Our client is a global leader in retail loss prevention, operations management, and analytics. For over 20 years, we have led the industry with innovative technologies, video analytics, and smart\-cart solutions. We are looking for an exceptional, hands\-on engineer to drive the deployment, management, and security of our software systems, cloud services, and complex data infrastructures within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
 



  





**\*The Role\*** 




 This role sits at the intersection of Platform and Data Engineering. You will be the primary custodian of our GCP environments, responsible for deploying, orchestrating, and securing not only our databases, but also the software systems and microservices that interface with them.
 



 Additionally, you will serve as our core GCP administrator, owning the full lifecycle of our cloud footprint. This includes provisioning new GCP projects, defining organizational hierarchies, and establishing enterprise\-grade security and permission boundaries.
 



 This is a highly autonomous, self\-managed role. We need an engineer who requires very little day\-to\-day management—someone who can architect infrastructure, write the necessary Terraform automation, secure the network perimeter, and safely deploy production\-grade software services, data platforms, and secure multi\-tenant GCP environments.
 



  





**\*Key Responsibilities\*** 




 GCP Tenant Administration, Software \& Service Deployment (Primary Focus)
 



 GCP Project Provisioning \& Landing Zones: Own the end\-to\-end provisioning and lifecycle management of all new GCP projects. Establish, automate, and document standard "landing zones" (VPCs, Shared VPCs, logging buckets, and default security guardrails) for new application environments.
 



 Organization Hierarchy \& Governance: Manage the GCP Organization structure (Folders, Projects, Billing Account linkages) and implement Organization\-level policies to prevent misconfiguration or unauthorized resource exposure.
 



 Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own the end\-to\-end design, implementation, and management of Terraform configurations to provision and manage all GCP resources (Projects, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, VPCs, IAM, Cloud Storage, and data systems) in a repeatable and modular manner.
 



 Service Deployment \& Orchestration: Package, deploy, and manage containerized software services and systems. Optimize workload deployments using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, or instance templates, ensuring robust health checking, service discovery, and logging.
 



 CI/CD Pipeline Automation: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, or similar) to support safe, zero\-downtime rollouts of software services, infrastructure updates, and database schema migrations.
 



  





**Monitoring, Alerting \& Observability:** 




 Implement comprehensive observability dashboards (using GCP Operations Suite/Stackdriver, Prometheus, or Grafana) to monitor system performance, application logs, service health, and infrastructure costs.
 



 Data Systems Engineering \& Security (Co\-Focus)
 



 Multi\-Region Data Management \& Global Compliance: As a worldwide organization, managing multi\-region data architecture is a critical part of this role. You will architect, deploy, and maintain globally distributed databases while ensuring strict adherence to global security standards, data sovereignty laws, and regional data residency requirements.
 



 Identity Access Management (IAM) \& Security Governance: Enforce strict security boundaries across all projects, services, and data systems. Define, manage, and audit Google Group\-based memberships, apply least\-privilege IAM policies, configure service accounts, manage secret distribution (using GCP Secret Manager), and manage security policies (KMS encryption keys, VPC Service Controls).
 



  





**Database Provisioning \& Management:** 




 Plan, deploy, and configure high\-performing databases across various paradigms to support our transactional and analytical workloads:
 



 Relational workloads in PostgreSQL.
 



 Highly scalable, low\-latency NoSQL systems in GCP BigTable.
 



 Enterprise analytical data warehouse environments in GCP BigQuery.
 



 Database Performance \& Optimization: Manage schema migrations, create optimized table definitions, establish indexing/partitioning strategies, and tune queries to ensure cost\-efficient performance at scale.
 



  





**Self\-Management \& Collaboration** 




 Autonomous Execution: Act as a self\-directed engineering unit. Take broad product and architectural requirements, translate them into technical implementation plans, and execute deployments with minimal supervision.
 



  





**Technical Ownership:**

title: Snowflake DBA
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a technically strong Snowflake Database Administrator to own end\-to\-end administration, performance engineering, security governance, and cost optimization of our Snowflake cloud data platform. This role requires deep hands\-on expertise across account/object administration, RBAC and security architecture, warehouse and query performance tuning, Python\-based automation, and Snowflake's native AI stack (Cortex AI, Streamlit\-in\-Snowflake). The candidate will act as the platform SME, partnering with data engineering, BI, security, and application teams to keep the platform performant, secure, cost\-efficient, and audit ready.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Platform Administration \& Operations** 



* Administer Snowflake accounts, databases, schemas, warehouses, resource monitors, and integrations across DEV/QA/UAT/PROD environments.
* Manage account\-level and object\-level parameters, network policies, and multi\-region / multi\-account topology.
* Configure and maintain storage integrations, external stages, external tables, and Snowpipe / Snowpipe Streaming for continuous data ingestion.
* Manage Time Travel, Fail\-safe, zero\-copy cloning, and data retention policies; validate and troubleshoot storage vs. Fail\-safe billing anomalies.



**Security, RBAC \& Governance** 



* Design and maintain a hierarchical RBAC model (functional roles → technical roles → system roles) aligned to least\-privilege principles.
* Own object ownership, grants management, future grants, and role inheritance across databases, schemas, and warehouses.
* Configure authentication mechanisms — SSO/SAML, RSA key\-pair, MFA — and manage service account lifecycle and key rotation.
* Implement data governance controls: row access policies, column\-level masking policies, tags/tag\-based masking, and object tagging for classification.
* Maintain audit readiness via ACCESS\_HISTORY, QUERY\_HISTORY, LOGIN\_HISTORY, and GRANTS\_TO\_ROLES monitoring, and support SOX/compliance audits.



**Performance Engineering \& Cost Optimization** 



* Tune virtual warehouse sizing, multi\-cluster scaling policies, and auto\-suspend/resume settings to balance performance vs. spend.
* Analyze and optimize query performance using QUERY\_PROFILE, clustering keys, search optimization service, and materialized views.
* Monitor credit consumption via ACCOUNT\_USAGE / ORGANIZATION\_USAGE views; build automated cost/usage dashboards and threshold\-based alerting.
* Diagnose storage anomalies (active vs. billed storage gaps, stuck Fail\-safe, table clone bloat) and drive resolution with Snowflake support.
* Own hybrid table, Snowpark\-optimized warehouse, and serverless feature (Snowpipe, tasks, dynamic tables) cost/performance trade\-off decisions.



**Automation, AI \& Application Enablement** 



* **Build and maintain Python\-based automation for RBAC provisioning, environment setup, health checks, and operational runbooks (mandatory).**
* Develop and maintain stored procedures / tasks for scheduled monitoring, alerting (e.g., cost or usage threshold alerts), and self\-healing operations.
* **Implement and support Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities — Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Functions (COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, SENTIMENT, TRANSLATE) — for GenAI\-driven use cases (mandatory).**
* **Design, deploy, and maintain Streamlit\-in\-Snowflake applications for internal tooling, dashboards, and self\-service data/AI access (mandatory).**
* Manage Cortex AI cost governance: token/spend monitoring by user/service account, tiered alerting, and chargeback reporting.



**Collaboration, CI/CD \& Documentation** 



* Support CI/CD pipelines for Snowflake object deployment (schema change scripts, version control, release gating).
* Partner with data engineering teams to troubleshoot ETL/ELT pipeline failures, connectivity issues, and data load errors.
* Maintain naming conventions, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and platform documentation for onboarding and knowledge transfer.
* Provide L2/L3 support for production incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes.



**Required Technical Skills** 




**Snowflake Core** 




 Account/object administration, virtual warehouses, micro\-partitions \& clustering, caching layers, Time Travel, Fail\-safe, zero\-copy cloning, resource monitors, hybrid tables, dynamic tables.
 



**RBAC \& Security** 




 Role hierarchy design, grants/future grants, network policies, SSO/SAML, RSA key\-pair auth, MFA, masking \& row\-access policies, object tagging.
 



**Performance Tuning** 




 Query profiling, clustering key strategy, search optimization service, materialized views, warehouse sizing \& multi\-cluster scaling.
 



**Cost Governance** 




 ACCOUNT\_USAGE / ORGANIZATION\_USAGE analysis, credit consumption monitoring, storage vs. Fail\-safe reconciliation, budget/threshold alerting.
 



**Python (Mandatory)** 




 Automation scripting, Snowflake Python Connector / Snowpark for Python, REST/CLI tooling, building internal utilities and monitoring scripts.
 



**SQL** 




 Advanced SQL for tuning, stored procedures (SQL/JavaScript/Python), CTEs, window functions, query optimization and rewrites.
 



**Cortex AI (Mandatory)** 




 Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Functions (COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, SENTIMENT, TRANSLATE, EXTRACT\_ANSWER), embedding/vector functions, AI cost/token monitoring.
 



**Streamlit in Snowflake (Mandatory)** 




 Building, deploying, and maintaining Streamlit\-in\-Snowflake apps for dashboards, admin tooling, and self\-service data/AI access.
 



**Data Loading \& Connectivity** 




 COPY INTO, Snowpipe / Snowpipe Streaming, external stages/tables, JDBC/ODBC/Python connector configuration and version management.
 



**Cloud Platform** 




 Working knowledge of underlying cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) — storage, networking, IAM as it relates to Snowflake.

 , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine\-seat A\&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 9,000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories.

 Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International."
