* Configure Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters and DAA connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data lake integrations.
* Implement initial load, continuous synchronization, and CDC MERGE patterns for migrations into Snowflake.
* Support homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Monitor replication latency, throughput, and availability; troubleshoot capture, delivery, trail, and performance issues.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical designs, deployment standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Support migration planning, cutover, rollback, incident resolution, and production support activities.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle GoldenGate implementation, administration, and production support experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate 19c, 21c, and 23ai, including Microservices Architecture, Integrated Extract, Classic Extract, Integrated Replicat, Parallel Replicat, Coordinated Replicat, and Big Data Adapters.
* Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of CDC, heterogeneous replication, data migration, high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake ingestion patterns including stage\-based loading, continuous replication, and MERGE\-based CDC processing.
* Good knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake, and Lakehouse architecture concepts.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer(Offshore)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Data Platform Engineer, P4**
**Summary/objective**
 The Senior Data Platform Engineer is a hands\-on technical owner of isolved's data platform infrastructure and day\-to\-day operations, working within the architectural vision set by the data architecture team. This role carries a lighter architectural mandate, though architectural thinking is still highly valued, in exchange for deeper, more hands\-on ownership of the systems that keep the platform running: administering and tuning Databricks and Snowflake, building and maintaining Fivetran, dbt, and Workato pipelines and integrations, and operating CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices in Terraform and GitHub Actions. This person is the engineer who configures, monitors, troubleshoots, and continuously improves isolved's data systems on a daily basis, escalating and partnering with the architects on larger design decisions while owning execution end to end.
   

  

**Core Job Duties**
* Administer and tune Databricks workspaces on a day\-to\-day basis, including Unity Catalog, access controls, service principals, cluster policies, secrets management, and cost optimization.
* Administer and tune Snowflake on a day\-to\-day basis, including warehouses, roles and RBAC, resource monitors, and secure data sharing configuration.
* Build, monitor, and maintain Fivetran connectors and incremental ingestion pipelines, troubleshooting sync failures and data quality issues as they arise.
* Build, test, and maintain dbt models, tests, and documentation, keeping transformation pipelines reliable and well\-governed.
* Write and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure) as code.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily in GitHub Actions, to automate testing, deployment, and infrastructure changes across the data platform.
* Write PySpark and Python code to build, optimize, and maintain data processing jobs and internal automation tooling.
* Monitor platform and pipeline health, troubleshoot issues, and lead or support incident response and root\-cause analysis for the data platform.
* Implement identity, access, and security controls (e.g., IAM, RBAC, secrets management) in line with standards set by the principal architects.
* Support pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow or equivalent) to sequence and monitor data workflows across ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
* Configure, maintain, and enhance data visualization tools like Power BI.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, documentation, and standards under the guidance of the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, without owning target\-state architecture directly.
* Partner with data engineering, data analytics, and the integrations team to translate architectural standards into working, well\-operated systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, automation, and cost efficiency, and raise architectural implications to the principal architects when they extend beyond day\-to\-day execution.
* Document architectural diagrams, operational runbooks, configurations, and troubleshooting guides for the systems you own.


**Job Complexity**
 Having wide\-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands\-on, go\-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).
   

  

**Interaction**
 Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise.
   

  

**Supervision**
 Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.
   

  

**Experience**
 Typically requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree; 6 years and a master's degree; or equivalent experience.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, data engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Seasoned customer engagement experience; professional services experience a huge plus.
* Deep, hands\-on experience administering Databricks, including Unity Catalog, cluster policies, service principals, secrets management, and cost optimization.
* Deep, hands\-on experience administering Snowflake, including warehouses, roles/RBAC, resource monitors, and secure data sharing.
* Deep experience building and maintaining Fivetran connectors and incremental ingestion pipelines.
* Deep experience with dbt, including models, tests, documentation, and CI integration.
* Deep experience building and maintaining Workato recipes and integration workflows.
* Strong CI/CD experience, ideally with GitHub Actions, including automated testing and deployment pipelines.
* Strong Terraform experience provisioning and managing cloud and data platform resources as code.
* Strong PySpark experience for large\-scale data processing, and solid Python skills for automation and internal tooling.
* Working knowledge of Azure and/or AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Comfort with Git\-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and incident response skills.
* Ability to operate effectively within architectural standards set by others, while still contributing ideas and technical judgment to architecture discussions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross\-functionally with architects, data engineering, analytics, and integrations teams.
* Experience with the following a plus (not required):
* io
* Workato
* Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools
* Hightouch
* Monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus)
* Data analytics
* AI/ML development
* Proficient in Python
* Nice to Have:
* Experience with modern BI tools (PowerBI, Looker, Mode, Hex, Tableau, etc.) Some exposure to Spark
* Background in experimentation (e.g., A/B testing infrastructure and analysis)


**About Isolved**
 isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people\-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers \- who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HR \& payroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high\-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and openminded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. title: GTM Data Architect
description:
***We’re building the AI\-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth!***
 We’re building the AI\-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth! Gainsight is the AI\-powered retention engine behind the world’s most customer\-centric companies. The Gainsight CustomerOS platform orchestrates the customer journey from onboarding to outcomes to advocacy. More than 2,000 companies trust Gainsight’s applications and AI agents to drive learning, adoption, community connection, and success for their customers. To explore how our suite of solutions is shaping the future of customer success, check out the link.
   

  

**About This Role**
 We’re looking for a full\-time GTM Data Architect to join our G\&A team reporting to the Chief AI \& Transformation Officer. This role is a hybrid role based out of our Hyderabad location.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll play a key role in building the foundation for how customer data is managed, connected, and activated across the GTM ecosystem, enabling scalable AI and digital strategies across the business. You’ll drive the architecture and governance needed to create a trusted single source of truth for customer identity, entitlement, and engagement data across systems like Salesforce, Gainsight, and other GTM platforms, supporting personalized experiences, campaign targeting, product adoption visibility, and measurement of digital impact at scale. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a highly cross\-functional, data\-driven environment and enjoys partnering with teams like Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Data \& Analytics. The ideal candidate brings strong skills in data architecture, systems integration and governance, and GTM data strategy.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect a unified customer data model spanning identity, entitlement, and usage across all GTM and product systems.
* Design and implement data pipelines that ensure reliable, near\-real\-time synchronization between CRM, CSP, PX, Community, Education, and other external data sources.
* Establish governance frameworks for data ownership, quality standards, and change management across systems and teams.
* Resolve identity fragmentation: standardize user and account keys, and reconcile duplicate records across disparate platforms.
* Integrate entitlement logic into GTM workflows so Sales, CS, and Digital teams can target campaigns and measure impact confidently.
* Partner with RevOps, Digital CS, and Analytics to design data systems with LLM\-readiness as a first\-order requirement—ensuring data models and semantic layers are interpretable by AI querying tools.
* Design for agent consumption alongside traditional BI, building deterministic answer frameworks that prevent hallucination in AI\-generated insights.
* Define data documentation and lineage so future projects build on a clear, stable foundation.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to align data design with system capabilities and release cycles.


**What We're Looking For**
* Senior IC / Architect level expertise: 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or GTM systems architecture, ideally in a SaaS or multi\-product environment.
* Deep understanding of customer and usage data models, identity resolution, entitlement management, and cross\-system integrations.
* Experience designing and optimizing data pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, etc.) to ensure high reliability and scalability.
* Strong grasp of CRM and CSP ecosystems (Salesforce, PX, Community, Education) and the logic of how data flows between them.
* Proven track record of establishing data governance and ownership models across multiple cross\-functional teams.
* Hands\-on technical fluency in SQL, schema design, and ETL architecture; ability to design scalable, reliable pipelines.
* Strategic mindset; capable of seeing the full GTM data landscape and translating business problems into technical design requirements.
* Clear communicator who can align complex technical architecture with RevOps, Digital, and Product stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AI\-ready data architecture principles, including semantic layer design for LLM querying and vector\-compatible data structuring.


*This is not a complete list of responsibilities, and the scope of the role may evolve with the needs of the team and business. This role will require occasional travel for team meetings, training, or company events.*
**Nice To Have Skills Or Experience**
* Experience with Gainsight and the broader Customer Success ecosystem (preferred asset, not a hard blocker).
* Experience with event\-based or product telemetry pipelines.
* Experience integrating multiple SaaS acquisitions or unifying identity across product lines.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
 Gainsight is a place where innovation is shaped through collaboration, curiosity, and a shared focus on solving real\-world problems. With a growing suite of products across customer success, product experience, community, education, and AI\-powered relationship intelligence, we continue to evolve with the needs of our customers. When people with diverse strengths, a strong sense of community, and true passion for our mission come together, they drive greater impact and create lasting value. What underpins it all is a culture that offers the stability, trust, and support that people need \- not just to do the job, but to show up as themselves and feel connected to the work they do. Gainsters love working here for several reasons. Here are a few:
   

  

**Our Compensation and Benefits:** 
 At Gainsight, we believe great work happens when teammates feel fully supported.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including full health coverage (including OPD), wellness and mental health resources, flexible remote work options, and childcare assistance. You'll also enjoy dedicated Recharge Holidays \- one long weekend each quarter to relax and reset.


**Our Core Values:** 
 We are guided by our values and our mission to be living proof you can win in business while being Human\-First. Learn more here.
   

  

**Our Growth Opportunities:** 
 From mentoring to career development opportunities, we’re passionate about helping our teammates learn, grow, and thrive.
   

  

**Our Parody Videos:** 
 No explanation needed. Just watch them here!
   

  

**If this sounds like the right role for you, we’d love to hear from you.**
**Additional Information**
*We’re committed to creating an inclusive, fair, and transparent hiring process. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a welcoming experience for all candidates.*

 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.

 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Business Intelligence Consultant, you will play a key role in modernizing business reporting and analytics at CIBC. This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business reporting assets to cloud\-based environments.
 



 You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, translate requirements into effective dashboards and analyses, and support the modernization of legacy SAS/SQL reporting solutions into Python\- and BI\-based reporting assets.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role. The primary focus is on business reporting, analytics, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets, logic, and code to modern reporting environments.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 




**Business Intelligence \& Reporting Delivery:** 



* Deliver business intelligence solutions including recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision\-making.
* Build, enhance, and maintain management reporting and self\-service dashboards for business users and leadership teams.
* Use Power BI or Tableau to create clear, scalable, and business\-friendly visual reporting solutions.



  





**Business Partnership:** 



* Partner directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand reporting priorities, define KPIs and metrics, and validate outputs.
* Translate business questions into actionable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Communicate insights and reporting logic clearly to business audiences.
* Reporting Modernization \& Migration
* Support the migration of legacy business reporting assets and SAS/SQL\-based reporting processes into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions.
* Convert and simplify legacy reporting logic into SQL and Python\-based workflows for reporting and analysis.
* Help modernize business\-owned reports, dashboards, and analytical code while preserving business logic and reporting accuracy.



  





**Data Analysis \& Preparation:** 



* Use SQL and Python to source, prepare, reconcile, validate, and analyze data for reporting purposes.
* Perform data checks and reconciliations to ensure reports are accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Apply sound business logic and data interpretation to reporting outputs.



  





**Governance \& Quality:** 



* Ensure reporting outputs align with data governance, control, and quality standards.
* Document assumptions, calculations, metric definitions, and reporting logic as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve report quality, usability, and efficiency.



  





**Collaboration:** 



* Work with business, analytics, and technology partners to enable reporting solutions and resolve data or reporting issues.
* Collaborate across teams while maintaining a primary focus on business intelligence delivery, not pipeline engineering or infrastructure ownership.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and streamline reporting workflows.
* Stay current with BI and analytics best practices and recommend improvements to reporting processes and tools.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support report migration, code conversion, and quality assurance.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* 7\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in SQL and Python
* Strong experience building dashboards and business reports using Power BI or Tableau
* Proven experience working with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver reporting solutions
* Experience with legacy reporting environments such as SAS and/or SQL\-based reporting assets
* Strong understanding of KPI development, report logic, reconciliation, and data quality validation
* Ability to translate business needs into dashboards, metrics, and analytical outputs
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Exposure to Azure and Databricks is a nice\-to\-have, not required
* Experience using AI or automation tools to support reporting migration or reporting quality is an asset.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 




**We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in:** 



* Business Intelligence Reporting
* Management reporting
* Dashboard development
* Ad hoc analytics
* Report migration / reporting modernization
* Stakeholder\-facing analytics delivery
* KPI and performance reporting
* Candidates whose background is primarily in ETL pipeline development, source\-to\-target data engineering, or cloud infrastructure management without strong business intelligence delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Job Dimensions:** 




 Individual contributor role focused on delivering business reporting and analytics solutions that support business unit goals High interaction with business stakeholders and reporting consumers Strong emphasis on reporting outcomes, dashboard usability, data quality, and insight generation Compliance Requirements Comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls

description:
**Project Role :** 
 Data Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :**

**Must have skills :** 
 Snowflake Data Warehouse
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Graph Databases, Data Engineering

**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Sumamry:
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise\-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions using Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities. In this role, the successful candidate leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real\-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, governed data products, Snowflake pipelines, and data cloud engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Engineer Snowflake\-based knowledge engineering solutions using Snowflake warehouses, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Native Apps/Streamlit, secure data sharing, governance features, APIs, and cloud storage integrations.
   

  

 Build Snowflake semantic data pipelines, knowledge graph enablement patterns, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope.
   

  

 Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.
   

  

 Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph\-powered data and AI offerings.
   

  

 Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions.
   

  

 Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre\-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities.
   

  

 Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems.
   

  

 Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods.
   

  

 Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms.
   

  

 Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client\-facing, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience building Snowflake\-based knowledge engineering solutions with warehouses, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Native Apps/Streamlit, secure data sharing, governance features, APIs, and cloud storage integrations.
   

  

 Strong Python and SQL experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, dbt, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling.
   

  

 Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise\-scale LLM applications.
   

  

 Ability to design and implement scalable semantic data pipelines, ontology/schema pipelines, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services on Snowflake.
   

  

 Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud/data platforms, with Snowflake specialization and exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP in multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Data Engineer, or related data cloud credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge\-driven use cases.
   

  

 External client\-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre\-sales exposure.
   

  

 Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The successful candidate will play a strategic role in shaping DTCC's Data Strategy and guide the organization in implementing it. They will develop the foundational standards, architectures, guidance, and controls for enterprise data capabilities to implement and monitor their implementation across the enterprise. They will develop data and semantic models to ensure our data is fit for purpose in transactional, analytical systems and by AI models and Agents.
   

  

**Leadership Skills**
* Technical vision \& architecture direction \- Sets the long\-term data modeling and architecture strategy aligned to business and regulatory roadmaps. Establishes guardrails and patterns that scale across the organization.
* Executive \& board\-level communication \- Translates complex data architecture and modeling concepts into clear business impact narratives for C\-suite, risk committees, and regulators. No jargon, full accountability.
* Cross\-functional collaboration \- Works effectively with business analysts, software engineers, risk, finance, compliance, and product teams to align on data definitions, integration contracts, and model fitness for purpose.
* Technology vendor evaluation \& negotiation \- Evaluates vendor platforms against enterprise requirements using structured scoring. Leads proof\-of\-concept exercises and negotiates commercial terms for data platform and tooling contracts.
* Mentoring \& technical coaching \- Develops junior and mid\-level team members through pair work, structured feedback, and stretch assignments. Builds team capability and independence rather than individual dependency on key staff.
* Familiar with agile / scrum delivery \- Runs or participates effectively in agile ceremonies. Breaks down complex data modeling and architecture initiatives into sprint\-sized deliverables with clear acceptance criteria and definition of done.
* Architecture governance \& technology standards \- Maintains the enterprise architecture standards register, technology radar, and approved patterns catalog. Manages exceptions process and ensures standards keep pace with platform evolution.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* 5\+ years experience as a Data Architect
* Expertise with data modeling concepts including 3NF, Kimball, Data Vault
* Experience in the Financial Services industry
* Excellent Communication Skills including presenting to large audiences and C\-Suite executive
* Ability to collaborate across technical and business teams
* The candidate must be familiar with Enterprise data architecture frameworks \- Applies TOGAF, Zachman, or DAMA\-DMBOK to design enterprise\-wide data architectures. Produces architecture views (conceptual, logical, physical, operational) aligned to business capability models.
* Experience producing Reference architectures \- Authors reusable reference architectures and blueprints for common patterns (e.g., regulatory reporting, real\-time risk, MDM hub). Ensures consistency across solution teams.
* Architecture documentation \& ADRs \- Produces clear, maintainable architecture documentation including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), sequence diagrams, component diagrams, and system context diagrams.
* Experience with data integration architecture \- Designs scalable integration patterns including batch ETL/ELT, Change Data Capture (CDC), event streaming, and API\-led connectivity. Understands idempotency requirements in financial reconciliation workflows.
* Experience with data mesh \& domain\-driven design \- Applies domain\-driven design (DDD) and data mesh principles — bounded contexts, domain ownership, data\-as\-a\-product — to decompose monolithic data platforms without sacrificing enterprise consistency.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses \- Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks (Lakehouse), Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or AWS Redshift. Understands platform\-specific optimization levers (clustering, partitioning, materialization).
* Experience with data lakehouse architecture \- Designs medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architectures. Understands Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Apache Hudi for ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time\-travel on object storage.
* Familiar with the tools in the modern data stack
* Subject matter expertise with Financial data domains \- Deep knowledge of core FS data domains: general ledger, trade \& position, risk, payments, customer/KYC, and reference data (instruments, counterparties, currencies).
* Familiar with data governance principles \- Champions data ownership, stewardship, and policy enforcement. Familiar with DAMA\-DMBOK, enterprise glossary management, and cross\-domain data standards governance.
* Experience with semantic layer \& data product design \- Designs reusable, business\-aligned semantic layers (metrics layers, logical data products) that decouple business logic from physical storage. Ensures consistent KPI definitions across the enterprise.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Senior Architect
description:
**Job Summary** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on, high\-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput transactional systems and cloud\-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities:System Design \& Architectural Leadership:
 * Own the end\-to\-end High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
* Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
* Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.


 Scalability, Performance \& Reliability:
 * Architect multi\-tenant, cloud\-native frameworks capable of handling high\-concurrency and petabyte\-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
* Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
* Oversee zero\-trust security compliance, fault\-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.


 Data \& Integration Architecture:
 * Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non\-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
* Scale event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real\-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.
* Optimize high\-throughput caching architectures (using Redis) to minimize database overhead for intensive financial computations.


 Engineering Culture \& Execution:
 * Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, driving proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, and cultivating an environment of fast, first\-principles execution.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management to scope technical roadmaps, decompose epic requirements into modular milestones, and proactively mitigate technical debt.


 Required Skills
 
 A technically deep engineering/product leader with:
 


* **Experience:** 
 12 \- 16 years of professional software engineering experience, with a minimum of 3 years successfully operating in a Technical Architect or Principal Engineer capacity for enterprise SaaS products.
* **Core Backend Stack:** 
 Expert\-level mastery of Java (Java 17\+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise\-grade backend frameworks. A profound understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, multi\-threading, and high\-concurrency programming models.
* **Distributed Systems \& Messaging:** 
 Proven experience in building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* **Database \& Storage Expertise:** 
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and NoSQL storage engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis). Hands\-on capability with query execution plans, partitioning, and database tuning under heavy write/read loads.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Infrastructure:** 
 Solid production experience with AWS (or Azure/GCP), containerization technologies (Docker), cluster orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise CI/CD deployment pipelines.

**Position Summary**
 Design and develop AI/GenAI solutions for Commercial Pharma data use cases, including enterprise knowledge search, insight generation, AI agents, natural language analytics and productivity accelerators. The role works from Vizag with data, platform, governance and business teams to build secure and scalable AI capabilities.
   

  

**Business / Program Context**
 The role is part of a Vizag\-based delivery capability supporting Commercial Pharma datasets across global markets. The work may include platform operations, data engineering, data quality, reporting, AI enablement, release governance and stakeholder support for enterprise commercial data products. The role is not limited to Japan\-specific datasets; Japan market familiarity may be useful but is not a mandatory baseline requirement for most positions.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop GenAI applications, AI agents and RAG\-based solutions for commercial data use cases.
* Build prompt engineering patterns, retrieval pipelines, LLM integration and model evaluation workflows.
* Use Databricks AI/Mosaic AI capabilities where applicable for model serving, vector search and experimentation.
* Integrate AI solutions with curated commercial datasets, knowledge bases, metadata and documentation repositories.
* Implement guardrails for security, privacy, accuracy, hallucination reduction and responsible AI usage.
* Partner with AI/Data Engineers, Platform Engineers and business stakeholders to industrialize AI solutions.
* Document solution design, evaluation metrics, prompts, data sources and governance controls.
* Work as part of a Vizag\-based delivery team supporting Commercial Pharma datasets and global commercial data stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business, technology, governance, quality and offshore/onshore delivery teams across time zones.
* Follow Agile delivery, SDLC, documentation, release, validation, access\-control and data\-governance standards.
* Contribute to knowledge management, reusable assets, SOPs, runbooks and operational excellence initiatives.
* Maintain strong communication discipline, including status updates, risk identification, issue escalation and timely stakeholder follow\-through.


**Required Work Experience**
* 4–8 years of relevant experience aligned to the role and seniority level.
* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare analytics, commercial data platforms or enterprise data programs.
* Experience working in a global delivery model with structured governance, documentation, SLAs and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to work from Vizag and collaborate effectively with India, global and client teams.


**Technical / Functional Skills**
* Python
* LLM integration
* RAG and Vector Databases
* Databricks AI / Mosaic AI
* Prompt engineering
* LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent
* Model evaluation
* AI governance and responsible AI


**Commercial Pharma Dataset Exposure**
* Pharmaceutical commercial data platforms
* Sales, prescription, claims, CRM and omnichannel datasets
* Customer master, HCP/HCO, product master, territory and alignment datasets
* Commercial KPIs, field force effectiveness, market share and promotional effectiveness
* Data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata and controlled release processes


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience supporting global pharma companies or commercial data programs.
* Exposure to Eisai\-like commercial operating models, field reporting, sales operations and analytics use cases.
* Japan market dataset exposure is preferred but not mandatory unless the assignment requires direct Japan business engagement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain data, risks, defects and business impact clearly.
* Certifications in Databricks, Informatica IDMC, Azure/AWS, Scrum, ITIL, Tableau/Power BI or AI/ML are preferred depending on role.


**Success Measures / KPIs**
* Secure, useful and governed AI solutions with measurable productivity, search, analysis or decision\-support value.


**Indicative 30 / 60 / 90 Day Expectations**
* First 30 days: complete onboarding, understand commercial data landscape, delivery processes, documentation standards and role\-specific tools.
* First 60 days: independently contribute to assigned workstreams, support issue resolution, produce required artifacts and participate in governance forums.
* First 90 days: demonstrate measurable ownership, improve delivery quality, identify improvement opportunities and support stable operations or project outcomes.

Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 Manager, Data Engineering role is a hands\-on QA tester / data engineer position within Schwab Data India focused on validating, testing, and supporting data engineering solutions that enable enterprise\-wide analytics and operational reporting. This role partners closely with product owners, developers, and quality engineering teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and well\-governed data pipelines and platform capabilities aligned with Schwab standards.
   

  

 As part of the OneSchwab/OneGCC model, this QA tester / data engineer contributes to high\-quality delivery through strong testing practices, data validation, automation, defect analysis, operational discipline, and close collaboration across global teams. The role is ideal for a technologist who enjoys ensuring data quality and delivery reliability in a fast\-paced, regulated enterprise environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Requirements \& Design Review: Review business requirements, source\-to\-target mappings, and technical design documents to identify validation needs, test coverage gaps, and quality risks, and provide timely engineering feedback.
* Test Planning \& Scenario Coverage: Review requirements, source\-to\-target mappings, and technical designs to identify test scenarios, edge cases, validation rules, and quality risks.
* Data Testing \& Validation: Write and execute SQL\-based data validations, reconcile source and target data, validate transformation logic, support functional and regression testing, and help resolve defects through root\-cause analysis.
* Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automation scripts and reusable test assets to improve validation coverage, repeatability, and release confidence across data engineering workflows.
* AI\-Assisted Automation Development: Use AI\-assisted tools and techniques responsibly to accelerate development of automation scripts, improve test design efficiency, and strengthen validation productivity while adhering to enterprise engineering and control standards.
* Defect \& Release Support: Coordinate with cross\-functional teams during test cycles and releases, track defects, validate fixes, and ensure timely completion of assigned testing and quality assurance activities.
* Documentation \& Test Standards: Maintain test documentation, validation evidence, reusable QA assets, and engineering artifacts in line with Schwab delivery and control standards.


**Required Qualification**
* 10\+ years of overall experience with strong hands\-on expertise in data engineering testing, ETL validation, QA automation, or data warehouse environments.
* Experience working on large\-scale data testing or data engineering quality assurance initiatives with strong hands\-on ownership of automation development in an Agile delivery model.
* Strong foundation in data validation, defect identification, troubleshooting, and quality engineering best practices across testing lifecycles.
* Ability to work collaboratively across product, development, and QA teams in a fast\-paced enterprise setting.


**Required Experience**
* Hands\-on experience in Data Warehouse and ETL testing, validation, or quality engineering, with demonstrated ability to develop automation scripts for test execution, reconciliation, and validation, preferably using IICS or PowerCenter.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern cloud\-based data engineering practices.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and basic Unix/shell scripting to develop automation scripts and support testing, validation, automation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to help create, refine, and optimize automation scripts and testing accelerators while applying sound engineering judgment, validation, and governance.
* Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Jira or Rally, with a solid understanding of software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect diagnosis, test evidence review, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high\-quality work within tight timelines.


**Skills And Attributes**
* Technical Depth: Strong hands\-on capability in data testing, validation, automation script development, and problem solving across enterprise data workflows.
* Quality Mindset: Focused on accuracy, completeness, traceability, and reliability across testing, validation, and release activities.
* Execution Focus: Able to prioritize effectively, work independently, and consistently deliver in a dynamic environment.
* Collaboration: Works well with cross\-functional teams and communicates issues, risks, and progress clearly.
* Continuous Improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve test automation, leverage AI\-assisted development responsibly, streamline validation processes, and strengthen quality engineering practices.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Bamboo, Bitbucket, GitHub
* Finance domain background .


**Job Sub\-Family Specific Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking \- Approaching a problem by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach
* Attention To Communication \- Ensuring that information is passed on to others who should be kept informed
* Business Acumen \- Ability to perform with insight, acuteness, and intelligence in the areas of the industry
* Make decisions and act in situations in which there is not enough information to be certain of outcome or implications of the decision
* Data Engineering Fundamentals – Strategically managing and operationalizing data pipelines and storage systems for data mining, analytics, and machine learning, prioritizing compliance, security, and scalability
* Personal Credibility – Demonstrated concern that one be perceived as responsible, reliable, and trustworthy
* Results Orientation – Focusing on the desired end result of one’s own or one’s units work
* Setting challenging goals, focusing effort on the goals, and meeting or exceeding them


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Expert D&T Technical Data Steward
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Expert Digital \& Tech Technical Data Steward
   

  

**City, Country:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

 As an Expert Digital \& Tech (D\&T) Technical Data Steward, you drive consistent, enterprise‑level execution of data governance and data management by providing hands‑on stewardship across data cataloging, data quality, metadata and lineage, issue resolution, and access control. You enhance and augment domain squads with targeted technical expertise, ensuring stewardship practices are harmonized, scalable, and fit‑for‑purpose. Implement, maintain, and document DQ rule changes following established change control processes.

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

title: Senior Data Governance Specialist [T500-29194]
description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As the Data Governance Lead, you will own and drive Stolt\-Nielsen’s enterprise approach to Master Data Management (MDM), data quality, cataloguing, and data lineage. Your mission is to ensure our core data — such as customers, vendors, products, assets, and other shared domains — is trustworthy, governed, documented, and reusable across business units and platforms.
 



 Your strongest focus will be to (further) implement and optimize Reltio Enterprise MDM, collaborating closely with business stakeholders (data stewards and data owners), and data engineering teams. You combine tool knowledge and configuration expertise with a strong understanding of data stewardship processes, policies, and operational workflows.

title: Senior Release Manager
description:
**Summary role description:** 




  





 Hiring for a Senior Technical Release Manager – Product and Professional Services, at Hyderabad, for supporting both standard product releases and custom product implementations for a US\-headquartered InsurTech SaaS platform client.
 



  





**Company description:** 




  





 Our client is a storied InsurTech platform provider whose products suite helps modernize the Life Insurance and Annuities industry. Their market\-leading digital solutions empower insurers with acquiring customers (policyholders) and to servicing their needs across the insurance lifecycle, with scalable, secure, performant and compliant software products for life insurance carriers, and their agents, employees, and consumers. These products are offered in multiple commercial and deployment models, comprising standard multi\-tenant SaaS, multi\-instance implementations, modular products with on\-premises, hosting and cloud deployment options. In this context, the role of the Senior Release Manager is business\-critical, calling for deep technical expertise combined with decision\-making in consultation with multiple client and internal stakeholders.
 



  





**Role details:** 








* **Role:** 
 Senior Technical Release Manager – Product Engineering and Service Transitions
* **Role level:** 
 Senior Manager
* **Reporting Manager:** 
 Head – Customer Success
* **Location:** 
 Hyderabad
* **Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid (2 days work from office, 3 from home)
* **Role type:** 
 Individual Contributor



  





**Role \& responsibilities:** 




  




* Upstream release readiness contribution, especially in an AWS deployment architecture context: Act as a technical gatekeeper, driving deep\-dive release readiness reviews, auditing "Release Manifests" (by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations), temporal workflow versioning for fail\-safe production, using Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
* Release Lifecycle Leadership: Hands\-on release and deployment leadership of core platform production updates and for customized deployments, as per Release Calendars agreed with clients and internal product teams
* Release processes design and execution, tooling, and documentation
* Environment Governance: Manage "Instance Parity" across AWS multi\-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensuring customer\-specific secrets and variables match our global standards
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate formal "Go/No\-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non\-technical readiness.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to Automated Production Quality Gates within our release pipelines



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 10\+ years of overall technical experience, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations, preferably also with expertise in IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation, and principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.
* 5\+ years of direct release management experience in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (multi\-tenant and multi\-instance).
* AWS cloud\-native release expertise, covering constructs like EKS, RDS Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK, Containerization (Kubernetes (K8s), ECS or Docker and their deployment patterns (Canary, Blue\-Green, or Rolling Updates).
* Stack fluency in one or more of Typescript, PHP, Go\-lang, Python and Node.js ecosystems, with reference to deployment nuances
* Modern orchestration expertise, including in Temporal (stateful workflows) and Kafka event streaming, with the ability to deploy "in\-flight" asynchronous processes, in a risk\-mitigated manner. You understand the risks of
* Strong database proficiency in MySQL and PostgreSQL, including in migration / transition releases
* Proven communication skills especially while handling release stage gates and Go/No\-go/Phased go type decisions
* Experience in Insurance or FS domains – highly preferred
* Deep knowledge of GRC, including SOC2/ISO, audit processes – highly preferred



  





**Assessment process:** 




  




* Interview by Head – Customer Success
* Interview by / technical interaction DevOps / SRE team
* Interview by Head – DevOps / SRE
* Interview by CTO
* Wrap\-up discussions with HR

The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining clinical and health economic data systems, ensuring high\-quality data integration, validation, reporting, and compliance across study and enterprise platforms.
   

  

 The position partners with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, automate processes, and deliver actionable insights through advanced analytics and reporting.

* Mentor junior colleagues and contribute to onboarding and knowledge sharing.
* Support release management activities, including change control and risk assessment.
* Lead UAT activities, translate requirements into technical specifications, and refine reporting standards.
* Communicate data and technical findings clearly and partner across teams to enable coordinated, high‑quality delivery.

 Minimum of 7 years’ experience working in database configuring, data engineering or data management operations, and 1\+ years of specific experience in Health Economic Modeling and upstream/downstream clinical data model configuring
   

  

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Exceptional communication skills (oral and written) with the ability to communicate with both the technical and business areas and external vendors.

* Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with different functional areas.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently under pressure, and adapt to changing environments.

* Desire and ability to learn new processes and technologies.
* Knowledge of SDLC and validation practices, including change control, release checklists, and traceability.
* Understanding of GCP, data integrity, audit‑ready documentation, and UAT/sign‑off procedures.
* Understanding of drug discovery process, FDA regulations, GxP guidelines, ICH guidelines, clinical database cleaning process, and 21 CFR Part 11\.
